data.one_liner: In-app performance diagnostics overlay surfacing jank, memory leaks, and bottlenecks.
data.what_it_does: Sleuth runs an in-app overlay that detects jank, memory leaks, slow networks, GPU pressure, and widget anti-patterns. Every detected issue ships with a fix hint, source line, and causal relationships.
use_when: You want to continuously monitor performance inside your Flutter app during development and profile runs.
You need structural checks like non-lazy list detection or missing repaint boundaries that standard DevTools might miss.
avoid_when: You are running in a production release build where the overlay is automatically dropped.
You require detailed heap snapshot object graphs, which are better suited for DevTools.
strengths: Runs directly inside the app without requiring an external tool connection for basic overlay views.
Provides actionable fix hints and source locations for every performance issue.
Includes 21 built-in detectors covering frames, layout, memory, network, and startup.
weaknesses: VM-connected detectors require running with --no-dds and profile/debug modes.
Reading the VM timeline can add minor isolate overhead on lower-end physical devices or simulators.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency, wrap your root app widget with Sleuth.track(child: MyApp()), and run with flutter run --profile --no-dds.
